CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108
  AND
  NO. 56, PINGDING RD., UNIT 56-7, 11TH FLOOR
  TAMSUI DISTRICT, NEW TAIPEI CITY, TAIWAN 251

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 1 of 5
   Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00
  p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  PRESENTATION

 NATIONAL SUICIDE PREVENTION WEEK SEPTEMBER 8-14, 2024

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN EXTENSION TO AN URGENCY
  INTERIM ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING A MORATORIUM ON THE
  INSTALLATION OF ARTIFICIAL TURF AND SYNTHETIC GRASS
  PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA CODE SECTION 65858 AND FIRST
  READING OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1413 AMENDING MUNICIPAL
  CODE  SECTIONS  14.18.07 (MAINTENANCE)  AND 23.16.03
  (DEFINITIONS) AND ADDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 23.16.24
  (PROHIBITION ON ARTIFICIAL TURF AND GRASS) TO PROHIBIT
  ARTIFICIAL TURF AND SYNTHETIC GRASS IN THE CITY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council conduct a public hearing and
  then adopt Urgency Ordinance No. O-23-1414-U, by a four-fifths vote, extending the
  existing moratorium and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. O-24-1413
  inclusive of the Planning Commission recommended changes. If the City Council
  agrees, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Urgency Ordinance No. O-24-1414-U, an Urgency Interim
  Ordinance of the City Council of San Marino Extending the Term of Ordinance No. O-
  23-1410-U, Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on the Installation of Artificial Turf
  and Synthetic Grass in the City of San Marino and I move to waive full reading and
  introduce by title only Ordinance No. O-24-1413, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending Municipal Code Sections 14.18.07 and 23.16.03 and adding
  Municipal Code Section 23.16.24 to prohibit the installation of artificial turf and
  synthetic grass in the City.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  APPROVAL TO PROCURE AND INSTALL IRRIGATION CONTROLLERS
  AND OUTPUT BOARDS FOR CITY-OWNED CENTER MEDIANS IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $63,693.13

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the procurement and
  installation of new Toro smart irrigation controllers, output boards and appurtenant
  devices from Imperial Sprinkler Supply in the amount of $63,693.13.

  “I move to approve the procurement and installation of new Toro smart irrigation
  controllers, output boards and appurtenant devices for the City’s landscaped center
  medians from Imperial Sprinkler Supply in the amount of $63,693.13.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF PURCHASE OF POLICE VEHICLE OUTFITTING FROM 10-
  8 RETROFIT, INC. IN THE AMOUNT OF $36,397.72

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the purchase of police
  vehicle outfitting from 10-8 Retrofit, Inc. in the amount of $36,397.72.

  “I move to approve the purchase of police vehicle outfitting from 10-8 Retrofit, Inc. in
  the amount of $36,397.72.”

 4.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-24-25 AUTHORIZING THE CITY
  MANAGER TO EXECUTE A TRANSFER AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT FOR TRANSFER OF
  MEASURE W, SAFE CLEAN WATER (SCW) PROGRAM FUNDS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve Resolution No. R-24-
  25 authorizing the City Manager to execute a Transfer Agreement with the Los
  Angeles County Flood Control District for Transfer of Safe Clean Water (SCW)
  Funds. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution No. R-24-25 authorizing the City Manager to execute
  a Transfer Agreement with the Los Angeles County Flood Control District for Transfer
  of Safe Clean Water (SCW) Funds.”
 5.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF JUNE 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of June
  2024.”

 6.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF JULY 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of July
  2024.”

 7.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR JULY
  2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of July 2024. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of July
  2024.”

 8.  RECEIVE AND FILE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR AUGUST
  2024

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 11, 2024  PAGE 4 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of August 2024. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  August 2024.”

 9.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the July 2024 minutes. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of July 10, 2024, the regular
  meeting of July 10, 2024, and the adjourned regular meeting of July 26, 2024.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
